coverage_note: Dallas ISD independent district comparison, 2024–25: exact CCD LEA 4816230 / TX-057905 / TAPR district 057905. All 189 audited enrolled grades 3–8/no-high-grade profiles are searchable; 188 enter each independent Math, ELA and Combined model. ELEMENTARY DISCIPLINARY ALTERNATIVE EDUCATION PRG (057905241) retains its original blank subject cells and has no residual; missingness never means zero. The complete linked audit retains all 249 CCD directory records, 239 operational/native campuses, 37 high, seven mixed, six primary-only and ten nonoperational records. Outcomes are original whole-percent All Students Meets or Above enrolled grades 3–8 Including EOC, with STAAR, Spanish and Alternate 2. Income uses precise October 25, 2024 individual economic-status counts divided by native enrollment, broader than uniform FRPL and tested pupils. Valid-score count scope and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals unavailable modelwide. Admissions, provider roles, programs, coordinates and boundaries remain unaudited; one year only.

methodology.summary: Dallas ISD independent original published-rate grade-school district models with precise same-year individual economic status; valid-score count scope and ten-valid-scored floor uncertified, sampling intervals unavailable.
details: Dallas ISD independent 2024–25 published-rate grade-school district models: exact operational CCD LEA 4816230 / native TX-057905 / TAPR district 057905 attachments. All 189 native enrolled positive grades 3–8/no-high-grade profiles remain searchable; 188 schools enter each separately fitted Math, ELA and Combined model using original whole-percent All Students Meets or Above displays and precise same-year individual economic-status enrollment ratios. The blank Alternative profile remains unmodeled. High, mixed, primary-only and nonoperational records remain outside this distinct point-only population. Valid-score count scope and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable modelwide.

Separate unweighted district OLS and externally studentized residuals retain all eligible schools and all 564 explicit deleted fits. Combined is the equal mean of original Math and ELA whole percentages with its own fit, deleted residual scale and studentization, not proficiency in both or averaged subject residuals. Filters never refit; statewide and Houston fits are never reused. Associations do not establish causal school effectiveness or overall quality.

Reconstruct exact operational same-year CCD attachments, complete native enrolled EE/PK/K/1–12 counts with positive grades 3–8 and zero grades 9–12, reconciled individual economic status and each original unmasked whole-percent R cell. Preserve all 189 grade-school profiles; blank Alternative campus 057905241 stays in source but outside all three 188-school fits. Reported tests/numerators, charter/type/reference labels and diagnostics never select membership.
Only original published whole-percent CDA38AM0E225R / CDA38AR0E225R. Do not reconstruct masks, substitute count-ratio precision, reuse statewide or Houston fits, or average grade percentages.

Individual October25,2024 PEIMS fall economic status, CP NTECO / NTALL, including free/reduced meal eligibility or other public assistance, codes01/02/99. Same-year all-enrolled EE–12 denominator; ED+nonED and native tenth-percent display must reconcile. This broader state-specific proxy is not uniform FRPL or household income; it does not exactly describe tested pupils.

CEP requires individual direct certification and annual local income surveys; universal meals do not classify all children. Provision2 can retain base-year eligibility for continuously enrolled students. Missing surveys may be00; undercount unknown. Jan16,2025 resubmission extension requires enrolled/eligible October25,2024; not another-year backfill.

Exact native 2024–25 All Students TAPR enrolled-grades3–8 Math/Reading Including EOC, At Meets Grade Level or Above: the original whole-percent R cells establish prospective outcomes. Native #Tests and #Meets-or-above remain unverified raw evidence. Accountability subset requires same district/campus on fall snapshot and testing date. STAAR with/without accommodations, Spanish STAAR, Alternate2 and corresponding AlgebraI/EnglishI–II EOC are included as documented. Separate TPRS all-testers, both-subject passing and participation measures are not used.

All 239 operational campuses reconcile native enrollment and individual ED plus non-ED. Enrollment 139,802 matches CCD school/LEA totals; separate TAPR membership totals 139,776 and differs at 16 campuses. Those administrative concepts remain distinct; equality or differences do not prove a cause or furnish tested denominators.

Original whole-percent displays differ from unverified reported-count ratios at 186 Math and 184 ELA grade-school members. Counts never supply more precise outcomes, certify score status, screen membership or complete missing cells. The Alternative campus 057905241 retains blank Math/ELA triplets. Mixed campuses 057905011 and 057905352 remain excluded despite middle reference labels because they have positive enrolled grade 9.

Valid-score count scope and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified. Native reported performance #Tests, enrollment, PEIMS/CCD membership, participation and federal 95%-rule counts never substitute for valid-score denominators. All valid-score counts, sampling variances and interval endpoints are null; sampling intervals unavailable. Studentization uses the deleted-school residual scale and N−3 degrees of freedom, without enrollment adjustment or shrinkage. Exact 2025 N/NAAR and M/medical scope remains unresolved; this release does not certify a ten-valid-scored minimum.

Full and all deleted designs have rank two and finite positive residual scales. Unbounded OLS predictions remain visible, including ELA predictions above 100%; no income endpoint or influential member is clipped or removed. Largest deleted-line changes over observed incomes are 2.011634 Math, 1.972519 ELA and 1.193460 Combined proficiency points. Leverage, Cook distance and residual flags are descriptive only.

The complete immutable source audit retains all 2,904 original records, 112,006 cells, full native headers and primary definitions. Compact normalized references preserve exact original rows/fields and all six audit/code/test pins; the full source must remain available and unchanged on every replay/import. Historical approvals remain false; only this validated grade-school contract is released.

One year only; programs are Unclassified and admissions/provider roles, map coordinates and district boundaries remain unknown. Varying grade and assessment mixes, rounded displays, broader fall economic status and omitted prior attainment/admissions remain limitations. State thresholds and income proxies do not create a common national ranking.
